videoDetails.title: Elon Musk makes AI predictions for an 'age of abundance,' notes 'jobs are going to change'
videoDetails.shortDescription:
President Donald Trump announced on Sept. 29 that he was planning to officially rebrand “artificial intelligence” to "super intelligence" in all government documents with an executive order to be signed later in the day.

Read more: https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/2026/09/29/trump-official-rebranding-ai-to-super-intelligence/92003107007/
videoDetails.author: USA TODAY
